My FREE guidebook, "The 5 Forks To Freestyle Cooking" will help you find the way.  Download it immediately at: http://www.WebCookingClasses.com/freestyle-cooking

summary.brief: A chef sautés vegetables, then builds and stirs a creamy Parmesan sauce on the stovetop.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a close‑up of a frying pan in which mixed vegetables are sizzling and beginning to brown over a burner. The scene then cuts to a man in a white chef’s coat, wearing a lapel microphone, who holds a bottle of olive oil. He pours the oil into a hot pot on the stove, adds chopped onion and minced garlic and sautés them briefly. He gradually adds hot stock in small amounts, stirring continuously as the mixture thickens. Finally he folds in a generous amount of grated Parmesan cheese, stirring until the cheese melts and the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. Throughout the demonstration the chef continues to stir, checks the texture, and speaks to the camera before the video fades to a black screen.

action.detailed: Add olive oil to the heated pot, sauté onion and garlic, gradually stir in hot stock while continuously mixing, then fold in Parmesan cheese and stir until the sauce is smooth and creamy.
action.actor: The male chef wearing a white chef’s coat and a lapel microphone.

summary.brief: A chef cooks Parmesan risotto by sautéing aromatics, slowly adding broth, and finishing with grated cheese.

He deglazes the mixture with a splash of white wine, letting the alcohol evaporate. Then he ladles hot chicken stock into the pan a little at a time, stirring constantly so the rice absorbs the liquid and becomes creamy. When the risotto reaches the right texture, he grates fresh Parmesan cheese over the top and folds it in until fully melted. The finished risotto is spooned into a serving bowl, and the segment ends with a short view of the pan’s flame dying down followed by a title screen advertising the cooking class website.
